notes.title: The Jackbox Party Pack 10 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[i]The Jackbox Party Pack 10[/i] was released on October 19th, 2023. On November 16th, 2023, players can expect an update to their game, including some bug fixes and additional features. If you spot a problem with your game or have a feature request or question, please submit a support ticket to help.jackboxgames.com. 

We are also pleased to announce that for the first time in Jackbox history, [i]The Jackbox Party Pack 10[/i] will include complete localization in Brazilian Portuguese. This localization features fully translated text and Brazilian-specific content. Learn more about this update [url=https://www.jackboxgames.com/blog/introducing-brazilian-portuguese-in-the-jackbox-party-pack-10]here[/url].

To get this free update, simply install [i]The Jackbox Party Pack 10[/i].
What’s in the patch:

[h1]Global[/h1]

[h2]Features[/h2]

- Brazilian Portuguese localization added!
- Various localization improvements and bug fixes

[h1]Tee K.O. 2[/h1]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[i]Tee K.O. 2 includes the following feature updates:[/i]

- Audience and players can now button-mash at certain times in the game to trigger visual effects
- Text Descriptions accessibility setting allows players to caption their drawings
- Updated credits visual design

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
[i]Tee K.O. 2 bugs that have been corrected:[/i]

- Refined Final Round experience
- Fixed bug around Final Round Winner drawing occasionally missing details
- Minor bug fixes

[h1]Timejinx[/h1]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[i]Timejinx includes the following updates:[/i]

- Added more content
- Updated audience scoring UI
- Updated text for Time Loop hints
- Added motion sensitivity toggle

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
[i]Timejinx bugs that have been corrected:[/i]

- Typos and misspellings
- Same player game-specific bugs like intro skipping and hints not showing
- Minor bug fixes

[h1]FixyText[/h1]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[i]FixyText includes the following updates:[/i]

- Player cursors are shown on the game screen as well the controller during text editing moments
- Refined controller experience with 3 suggestions to cycle through in the writing moment, and fewer tool tips on waiting screens
- Improved game feedback in voting moments

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
[i]FixyText bugs that have been corrected:[/i]

- Text input at the end of the timer is now represented on the game screen
- Text-to-speech voice for the French version has been replaced
- Minor bug fixes

[h1]Dodo Re Mi[/h1]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[i]Dodo Re Mi includes the following updates:[/i]

- New songs and new instruments
- Ability to unlock more instruments on a song
- Tutorial has more instruments to play
- New combo flame and audience survival rates in post-game screen

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
[i]Dodo Re Mi bugs that have been corrected:[/i]

- Improved messaging in-game moments
- Minor bug fixes

[h1]Hypnotorious[/h1]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[i]Hypnotorious includes the following updates:[/i]

- Splitting content between rounds one and two
- Allowing players to switch groups during re-roll
- Players receive different hints
- Players can change their accusations

[h2]Bugs[/h2]
[i]Hypnotorious bugs that have been corrected:[/i]

- Fixed player names staying onscreen during the grouping phase
- Fixed group labels during grouping reveal
- Fixed transition moments and timing
